taxon_match.method: Exact unambiguous source scientific name to one Project Isitusa catalog species after Unicode, whitespace, and case normalization

geography_match.method: The retained point coordinate resolves inside exactly one active county equivalent in the provider-declared state; the county name is the registered active county name derived from that geometry

spatial_scope: Point occurrence at 43.4040214, -87.93874568 inside 55089; not a complete county inventory.
caveats: The retained observation supports historical recorded presence only.
It does not establish current abundance, countywide distribution, or present-day establishment.
Source silence, excluded rows, zero values, and rejected rows create no absence or non-detection claim.
